$description: Mechanical mapping from primitive colour classes to semantic colour token classes for every kit component except Button (already converted in bde797e). Paths are relative to packages/gov-ui-kit. For each file, `entries` lists every primitive colour class occurrence in source order: `old` is the class exactly as written (variant prefix included), `new` its exact replacement (one or more classes; every class keeps the variant prefix of `old`) or null when the class stays as it is, with the reason. Apply entries by line; when a line holds the same `old` twice, entries are in column order. Validated by scripts/validate-semantic-component-map.mjs, which proves that every replacement keeps the default-theme colour.
conventions: Role first, value second: a part takes a level role (primary/secondary/tertiary) when its colour does not react to interaction, and state roles (default/hover/active/selected/disabled) when its own colour changes on hover, press, focus or selection. A part that only dims when disabled stays a level token and uses */disabled for the disabled variant.

Static text levels in today’s colours: text/surface/primary = neutral-800 (titles, values), secondary = neutral-500 (descriptions), tertiary = neutral-400 (meta lines); static fills: bg/surface/primary = neutral-0, secondary = neutral-50 (skeletons, icon wells), tertiary = neutral-100 (tracks, neutral tag); static borders: border/surface/primary = neutral-100.
Keyboard highlight and focus-visible take the hover token where the component styles them exactly like hover (DropdownItem data-highlighted, DataListItem focus-visible).
A focused input field is its active state (border/accent/active, border/<status>/active); focused + hovered is still active.

focus-ring-<colour> becomes `focus-ring ring-<group>-focus` with no variant on the colour class: focus-ring applies the ring width under :focus-visible and :has(:focus-visible), and an unprefixed colour keeps both cases (Button uses focus-visible:ring-*, which only covers the element itself).

Shadow tokens carry geometry and colour: shadow-neutral-sm/shadow-neutral/shadow-neutral-md become shadow-surface-sm/-default/-md, shadow-primary* become shadow-accent-*, status shadows shadow-<status>-*.

Unconverted classes keep their primitive class unchanged. Reason codes: conflict (role token fixed at another value elsewhere: a designer decision), no-utility (no token utility for that CSS property or shape), no-token (no token for that role: one-off), forbidden-token (role sits in the unresolved *-inverse family or bg/info/secondary), comment (not a class in use), ordering (the role token fits, but renaming would change which of two classes on the same element wins; convert together after a small restructure).

Ordering: Tailwind orders same-property utilities of the same variant alphabetically (numbers numerically), so renaming can change which of two simultaneous classes wins. The validator checks every same-variant same-property pair in a file and the cross-component overrides listed below.
